complexity_assessment.reasoning: Standard complexity: routing logic is well-scoped, but requires careful integration with loop iteration tracking, stuck detection based on convergence scores, and multi-tier cost tracking. Backward compatibility with existing loop behavior is critical.

skill_rationale.cost-optimized-model-selection: Core skill for implementing per-iteration model routing algorithm, stuck detection escalation logic, and cost tracking per model tier—directly addresses the issue's acceptance criteria.
skill_rationale.architecture-design: Design the integration points with sw-loop.sh (iteration tracking), sw-model-router.sh (model selection), and daemon-config.json (strategy configuration) to avoid conflicts and ensure maintainability.
skill_rationale.adversarial-quality: Probe edge cases in stuck detection (3-iteration window sensitivity), routing boundaries (final 20% threshold), and escalation triggers to prevent cost overruns or under-powering decisions.
skill_rationale.testing-strategy: Create comprehensive test suite covering routing logic across loop sizes, stuck detection false positives/negatives, cost tracking per model tier, and configuration variations (default/aggressive/conservative).
skill_rationale.pr-quality: Synthesize changes to sw-loop.sh, lib/loop-model-selection.sh, sw-model-router.sh, and daemon-config.json into a reviewable PR that clearly shows the routing algorithm and integration points.
skill_rationale.documentation: Update CLAUDE.md under 'Build Loop Capabilities' and 'Cost Intelligence' sections with new routing strategy, configuration schema, and cost tracking behavior for future agents.
skill_rationale.deploy-safety: Verify new routing doesn't break existing pipeline runs with default configuration; test backward compatibility with daemon-config.json lacking the new loop_model_strategy field.
skill_rationale.observability: Add cost tracking metrics per model tier within loop iterations; track escalation triggers and stuck detection false positives in real daemon runs to validate assumptions.
skill_rationale.validation-thoroughness: Run actual build loop end-to-end with new routing against a multi-iteration task; verify cost savings match predictions and no regressions in final code quality vs. baseline.

review_focus: Stuck detection reliability: Is 3-iteration window appropriate for all task types? Should it be configurable?
Routing boundaries: Does final-20%-uses-Opus scale correctly for loops with 5 iterations vs 50 iterations?
Convergence score integration: How does loop pass it to model selection logic? What if convergence score is unavailable?
Backward compatibility: Loops in old daemon-config.json (no loop_model_strategy) must work with sensible defaults.
Cost tracking accuracy: Per-model-tier tracking must not be lost across loop restarts or session handoffs.
Configuration schema: daemon-config.json must document default/aggressive/conservative strategies and their implications.
Integration seams: Verify sw-loop.sh calls new lib/loop-model-selection.sh at right points; no double-wrapping with sw-model-router.sh.
risk_areas: Stuck detection false positives leading to unnecessary escalation and cost overruns on slow-but-progressing tasks
Routing threshold (final 20%) miscalculation on small loops (5 iterations = 1 iteration at Opus may be too early)
Convergence score reliability varies by task type (coding vs tests vs refactor); escalation may fire at wrong time
Cost tracking loss if loop restarts mid-iteration or session is suspended, leading to inaccurate cost reports
Existing daemon-config.json missing loop_model_strategy field; silent fallback to wrong defaults could break cost model
Conflict with per-stage model routing in sw-model-router.sh (both trying to select model) causing double-wrapping or override bugs
